title: nf-core/teannotate samplesheet schema
description: Schema for the input samplesheet CSV used by nf-core/teannotate

sample.errorMessage: Sample name must contain only alphanumeric characters, underscores, hyphens, or dots.

genome.errorMessage: Genome must be a path to an existing FASTA file (.fa, .fasta, .fna, optionally .gz).

organism_type.errorMessage: organism_type must be one of: plant, animal, fungus.

gff.errorMessage: gff must be a path to an existing gene-annotation file (.gff, .gff3, .gtf, optionally .gz).
gff.help_text: Optional GFF3 of gene models. Required only for fungal genomes to run Starfish/Starship annotation (starfish annotate -g). Genomes without it skip Starfish and continue.
